facts.finding: Support table: EVM charge Client No, Server Yes. Ruby HTTP client does not sign EVM or x402 credentials.

createX402Server builds createCdpFacilitatorClient from CDP credentials and passes it to x402ResourceServer; its config has no facilitator-client injection. Official low-level x402 APIs are separate mandatory rows.
